> [!WARNING]
> Early alpha: expect graphical, animation and sound bugs, and plenty of rough edges.
>
> So far the game has been tested from saves only: a full playthrough from the very start to the end has not been done yet. There may be bugs that only show when playing straight through, such as the one in the Woodside Apartments. **Issue reports are very welcome**, whatever you find.

The second alpha of sh2-vita. Mostly fixes to what you see and hear while playing, and a few tools for testing on the console.

### Changes

- **Camera:** the view is now built from the camera's own axes, as the original does, instead of a look-at through eye + direction.
- **Doors:** the open areas' tile now has floor under the arrival, so Wood Side's gate leads into its courtyard.
- **Rooms:** textures are sampled down to 64, against the walls' shimmer when the camera turns.
- **Characters:** James turns through the frame between walking and turning on the spot. Eddie keeps hold of his pizza, and the pizza waits for him.
- **Stages:** the characters the room code places now appear, along with the stages' own sounds.
- **Combat:** a gunshot lights the room, with an option to turn it off. View Control Normal is available on the Vita.
- **Packer:** a Docker image that makes the Vita's data, with install steps that work. No pack is made without the Enhanced Edition.

### For testers

- SELECT + D-pad up records a trace of the camera's last minute.
- SELECT + D-pad down shows a burst of 16 frames.
- An experimental attempt to time the frame beat from when frames reach the screen.

The known problems and what is still open are listed in [STATUS.md](https://github.com/AngeloGalav/sh2-vita/blob/main/port/STATUS.md).
